title: The Last Coffee Ceremony
logline: A young woman rediscovers her grandmother's stories through a quiet coffee ceremony.

grandmother.descriptor: Fictional Ethiopian grandmother in her seventies, wearing a white cotton netela shawl, warm lined face.

granddaughter.descriptor: Fictional Ethiopian woman in her twenties, simple contemporary clothing, thoughtful expression.

music.prompt: Instrumental Ethiopian-inspired acoustic score, warm krar and soft hand percussion, reflective opening, hopeful ending.

shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a quiet Ethiopian home courtyard at sunrise, coffee setup visible.

narration.text: እንደ ተለመደው ጠዋት በቡና ሽታ ተጀመረ።
narration.subtitle_text: The morning began, as always, with the smell of coffee.

shots.subtitle_en: The morning began, as always, with the smell of coffee.

shots.image_prompt: Close view of coffee beans being roasted in a traditional pan over charcoal.

narration.text: አያቴ ሁልጊዜ በቡና ማቁላት ትጀምር ነበር።
narration.subtitle_text: My grandmother always began by roasting the coffee.

shots.subtitle_en: My grandmother always began by roasting the coffee.

shots.image_prompt: Grandmother prepares the jebena beside small cups, warm window light.

narration.text: እያንዳንዱ ስኒ ታሪክ ይይዛል ትለኝ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_text: She used to tell me that every cup held a story.

shots.subtitle_en: She used to tell me that every cup held a story.

shots.image_prompt: Granddaughter sits opposite her grandmother and listens carefully.

narration.text: በዚያ ቀን አንድ ታሪክ እንድትነግረኝ ጠየቅኋት።
narration.subtitle_text: That day, I asked her to tell me one of those stories.

shots.subtitle_en: That day, I asked her to tell me one of those stories.

shots.image_prompt: Grandmother smiles while holding a small coffee cup, intimate portrait.

narration.text: ስለ ትዕግሥት፣ ስለ ሥራ እና ከእኛ በፊት ስለነበሩት ሰዎች አወራች።
narration.subtitle_text: She spoke of patience, work, and those who came before us.

shots.subtitle_en: She spoke of patience, work, and those who came before us.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of two hands passing a small coffee cup across a low table.
shots.motion_prompt: slow focus shift from cup to hands

narration.subtitle_text: I understood that listening is also a way of remembering.

shots.subtitle_en: I understood that listening is also a way of remembering.

shots.image_prompt: The two women sit together in the courtyard as afternoon light softens.

narration.text: የቡናው ሥነ ሥርዓት ተጠናቀቀ፤ ታሪኩ ግን ከእኔ ጋር ቀረ።
narration.subtitle_text: The ceremony ended, but the story stayed with me.

shots.subtitle_en: The ceremony ended, but the story stayed with me.

shots.image_prompt: A quiet still life of the jebena and cups in golden evening light.

narration.subtitle_text: Traditions live on when we share them.

shots.subtitle_en: Traditions live on when we share them.

style.block: Cinematic naturalistic Ethiopian home interior, warm dawn light, earthy palette, realistic film grain.
